title: 011 大声说话者斩杀-《第19次末日》
content:
第(1/3)页

    赵铁军一见山鸡先是一愣，虽然不知道那她是怎么抓到的，但想到她的情况，这东西他可不能要，当即就是连连摆手。

    原来是好多人看到了李天运的玩法，认为他在开挂，跑去后台举报了。

    地面之上的天才们也有还在时刻监视着高空之上的人，他们也担心高空之上的人会突然下来攻击他们。

    恩瑞克这个乌克兰人，虽然被刚刚被王震那一个大巴掌给羞辱的失去了理智，但是他这样善于炒作，善于挑衅，善于营销自己的新一代“嘴炮型”拳手哪一个是善茬，那一个不是心机深沉的人尖子？

    苏怡看着笑悠然那副心不在焉的闲散样子，恨不得一脚踢在他的屁股上。

    但如果这次的交易成功，对方让协会内天赋极高的几个年轻人都得到了灵魂方面的提升，那么在未来他们将要面对不知道多少世界的攻击的时候肯定会显得更加游刃有余。

    比赛继续进行，王震也有些敬佩这位芦源流的空手道黑带大师的意志力，趁热打铁痛打落水狗之前还是主动的把自己的右手向上倾斜四十五度伸出，跟大胡子碰了一下拳套，表示了一下友好。

    前手勾拳，后手直拳，前手斜勾拳，低扫腿，等等等，最擅长的高密度进攻寻找对手防守空挡的王震在这一刻将这个时代，站立格斗的最高水准，完全展现在了在场的所有人面前。

    他都到了娶妻之龄了，还在大街上和人家姑娘同桌吃饭，还闹出那等丑闻来。

    “你把他们两个男人叫来就好了，把我叫来干嘛。”奚蕊噘嘴说道。

    栾飞仿佛看妖孽似的看着杨菁，这美丽的躯壳下，究竟是什么样的七窍玲珑心，怎么就一口咬定大宋真正的精锐之师将要在郓城县诞生？

    双方在对视中，地面开始猛烈的晃动起来，刺耳的嘶吼从塔外传来。

    见他不满地晃动着脑袋，躲开她的手，却连眼也舍不得睁得模样，不由笑了开来。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Zhao Tiejun was stunned when he saw the pheasant. Although he didn't know how she caught it, but considering her situation, he couldn't have this thing, so he immediately waved his hands.

It turns out that many people saw Li Tianyun’s gameplay, thought he was cheating, and went to the backstage to report it.

Some of the geniuses on the ground are still monitoring the people high in the sky. They are also worried that the people high in the sky will suddenly come down to attack them.

Although Enrique, a Ukrainian, has lost his mind after being humiliated by Wang Zhen's big slap just now, he is so good at hype, provocation, and marketing of his new generation of "talking" boxers. Which one is good, and which one is not a scheming top fighter?

Su Yi looked at Xiao Youran's absent-minded and idle look and wished she could kick him in the butt.

But if this transaction is successful and the other party allows several extremely talented young people in the association to improve their souls, then they will definitely be more able to face attacks from countless worlds in the future.

As the competition continued, Wang Zhen also admired the willpower of Lu Yuanliu's black belt karate master. Before striking while the iron was hot and hitting the drowned dog, he took the initiative to tilt his right hand upwards at a forty-five degree angle and touched the glove with the bearded man as a gesture of friendship.

Front hand hook, back hand straight punch, front hand oblique hook, low leg sweep, etc. Wang Zhen, who is best at high-density attacks to find gaps in the opponent's defense, fully demonstrated the highest level of stand-up fighting in this era in front of everyone present at this moment.

He is already old enough to marry, but he is still eating at the same table with other girls on the street, and causing such scandals.

"You can just call these two men here. Why call me here?" Xi Rui said with a pout.

Luan Fei looked at Yang Jing as if he were a monster. What kind of exquisite heart was underneath this beautiful body? Why did he insist that the real elite master of the Song Dynasty would be born in Yuncheng County?

As the two sides looked at each other, the ground began to shake violently, and a harsh roar came from outside the tower.

Seeing him shaking his head in dissatisfaction and avoiding her hand, but not even willing to open his eyes, he couldn't help but laugh.
